title: Banh Flan
description: Banh Flan is a dish from Vietnam prepared with chicken egg, evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Heat the listed ingredients over moderate heat, stirring only as needed, for about 8 minutes until amber and fragrant.
Whisk the listed batter ingredients until smooth. Let the mixture rest briefly so the flour hydrates.
Set the caramel-lined flan mould in a larger baking dish of hot water and gently bake at 150–160°C until the custard is just set, about 40–50 minutes; chill before unmoulding.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 180 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
